'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Angelo Consoli LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Angelo Consoli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif|label=Quiet Mining Colony}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
